layout.name: Simple Combo Chart
layout.layoutData:
<# var msg = tw.resource.toolkit.TWSYS.ChartMessages; #>

chart {
	antiAliasing : "true";
	antiAliasingText : "true";
	backgroundPaint : "#ffffffff";
	border : "@#border12";
	header : "@#label9";
	labels[0] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleCombo.bar1.label") #>";
	labels[1] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleCombo.bar2.label") #>";
	labels[2] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleCombo.bar3.label") #>";
	labels[3] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleCombo.bar4.label") #>";
	legendPosition : "South";
	legendVisible : "true";
	name : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleCombo.name") #>";
	opaque : "true";
	preferredSize : "446,291";
	projectorReversed : "false";
	renderingType : "COMBO";
	sampleSeries[0] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleCombo.dataSet1.text") #>,15,10,15,10:BAR";
	sampleSeries[1] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleCombo.dataSet2.text") #>,8,12,18,22:BAR";
	sampleSeries[2] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleCombo.lineSet1.text") #>,(0,3),(1,7.5),(2,5),(3,7.5):LINE";
	sampleSeries[3] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleCombo.lineSet1.text") #>,(0,35),(1,30),(2,22),(3,18):LINE";
	XGridVisible : "false";
	YGridVisible : "true";
}

chartGrid {
	fill : "true";
	majorPaint : "#FFedf2f6";
	majorStroke : "@=stroke8";
}

chartLegend {
	antiAliasing : "true";
	antiAliasingText : "true";
	background : "#ffffffff";
	border : "@#border11";
	followChartResize : "true";
	font : "SansSerif,10";
	foreground : "black";
	paintingBackground : "true";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="-1"] {
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	labelColor : "#ff000000";
	labelFont : "SansSerif-10";
	labelRotation : "0";
	majorTickVisible : "true";
	title : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleCombo.bottomAxis.title") #>";
	titleColor : "#ff000000";
	titleRotation : "-0.0";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="0"] {
	autoDataRange : "true";
	foreground : "#FF4680B3";
	labelColor : "#FF4680B3";
	labelFont : "SansSerif-10";
	labelRotation : "0";
	majorTickVisible : "true";
	title : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleCombo.leftAxis.title") #>";
	titleColor : "#FF4680B3";
	titleRotation : "-90.0";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="0"] axis {
	autoVisibleRange : "true";
}



series[index="0"] {
	color1 : "@=color2";
	renderingType : "CLUSTERED_BAR";
}

series[index="1"] {
	color1 : "@=color3";
	renderingType : "CLUSTERED_BAR";
}

series[index="2"] {
	color1 : "#ff008000";
	color2 : "#ff008000";
	marker : "CROSS";
	markerSize : "5";
	renderingType : "POLYLINE";
	stroke : "@#stroke4";
}

series[index="3"] {
	color1 : "#ffffa500";
	color2 : "#ffffa500";
	marker : "TRIANGLE";
	markerSize : "5";
	renderingType : "POLYLINE";
	stroke : "@#stroke5";
}

Subobject#border10 {
	bottom : "2";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "2";
	right : "2";
	top : "2";
}

Subobject#border11 {
	bottom : "4";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "4";
	right : "4";
	top : "4";
}

Subobject#border12 {
	bottom : "1";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "1";
	right : "1";
	top : "1";
}

Subobject#border7 {
	bottom : "2";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "2";
	right : "2";
	top : "2";
}

Subobject#color2 {
	adapting : "true";
	class : "ilog.views.util.java2d.IlvLinearGradientPaint(start,end,stops,colors,spreadMethod,colorSpace,transform,adapting)";
	colors[0] : "#FF87C0E8";
	colors[1] : "#FFC5DFF4";
	colorSpace : "SRGB";
	end : "0.5,0.0";
	spreadMethod : "PAD";
	start : "0.5,1.0";
	stops[0] : "0.0";
	stops[1] : "1.0";
}

Subobject#color3 {
	adapting : "true";
	class : "ilog.views.util.java2d.IlvLinearGradientPaint(start,end,stops,colors,spreadMethod,colorSpace,transform,adapting)";
	colors[0] : "#FFFEC658";
	colors[1] : "#FFFEEDCC";
	colorSpace : "SRGB";
	end : "0.5,0.0";
	spreadMethod : "PAD";
	start : "0.5,1.0";
	stops[0] : "0.0";
	stops[1] : "1.0";
}

Subobject#label6 {
	border : "@#border7";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.swing.IlvJLabel";
	font : "SansSerif-16";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	horizontalAlignment : "0";
	text : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleCombo.header") #>";
}

Subobject#label9 {
	border : "@#border10";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.swing.IlvJLabel";
	font : "SansSerif-16";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	horizontalAlignment : "0";
	text : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.SimpleCombo.header") #>";
}

Subobject#stroke4 {
	class : "java.awt.BasicStroke(lineWidth,endCap,lineJoin,miterLimit,dashArray,dashPhase)";
	dashPhase : "0.0";
	endCap : "0";
	lineJoin : "2";
	lineWidth : "1";
	miterLimit : "3.732051";
}

Subobject#stroke5 {
	class : "java.awt.BasicStroke(lineWidth,endCap,lineJoin,miterLimit,dashArray,dashPhase)";
	dashPhase : "0.0";
	endCap : "0";
	lineJoin : "2";
	lineWidth : "1";
	miterLimit : "3.732051";
}

Subobject#stroke8 {
	class : "java.awt.BasicStroke(lineWidth,endCap,lineJoin,miterLimit,dashArray,dashPhase)";
	dashPhase : "0.0";
	endCap : "0";
	lineJoin : "2";
	lineWidth : "1";
	miterLimit : "3.732051";
}
